svg.text: Q2: radius 3 on both edges of a 4 wide face: at once or one after the other
an existing fillet is part of the shape the next fillet sees, so a sequence cannot equal a single operation
A. at once = intersection (CHOSEN for one operation) (CHOSEN)
the intersection of the two rounded profiles.
B. one after the other (the result of the rule) (CHOSEN)
the first fillet's tangent edge is the second one's
pivot: the second arc leaves it at 138 deg.
Same rule, applied to a different shape.
C. make both equal: decline the sequence
refuse the second fillet when it runs past the first
fillet's tangent edge. Order independent by
construction, at the cost of IsDone false.
